name: Burst of Shadows
body:
School illusion (shadow) [shadow]; Level death mage 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 5-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a tear into the shadow plane for a brief moment. A mass of undead shadows reach out and affect those within the burst. Each creature takes 1d6 Strength damage and is dazed for 1 round. A successful Fortitude save reduces the Strength damage to 1 and negates the dazing. A creature occupying multiple squares of the burst are affected by this spell a second time, though they get a save against the second set. The dazed effect does not stack.
